agent_execution_logs.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `agent_execution_logs` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `agent_name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `node_name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `input_state` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `output_state` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `llm_model` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `prompt_tokens` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_tokens` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `latency_ms` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_agent_execution_logs_request_id` (`request_id`),
  KEY `ix_agent_execution_logs_agent_name` (`agent_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

alembic_version.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `alembic_version` (
  `version_num` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`version_num`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

analysis_results.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `analysis_results` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `raw_data_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `risk_score` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `risk_level` enum('low','medium','high','critical') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `anomaly_tags` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `reasoning` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `facts_summary` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `raw_data_id` (`raw_data_id`),
  KEY `ix_analysis_results_request_id` (`request_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `analysis_results_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`raw_data_id`) REFERENCES `raw_data` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

decision_results.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `decision_results` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `analysis_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `decision` enum('approve','reject','escalate','pending_review') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `confidence` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `explanation` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `decision_path` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `reflection_passed` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `analysis_id` (`analysis_id`),
  KEY `ix_decision_results_request_id` (`request_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `decision_results_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`analysis_id`) REFERENCES `analysis_results` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

raw_data.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `raw_data` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `payload` json NOT NULL,
  `data_hash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','processed','invalid') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'pending',
  `quality_score` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `processed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `data_hash` (`data_hash`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_created` (`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_source` (`source_type`,`source_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

rule_nodes.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `rule_nodes` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `parent_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `rule_name` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `rule_type` enum('condition','action','group') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `condition_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `field_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `operator` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `threshold_value` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `logic_op` enum('AND','OR','NOT') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'AND',
  `weight` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `action_params` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `priority` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_rule_nodes_parent_id` (`parent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `rule_nodes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `rule_nodes` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

rule_versions.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `rule_versions` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `rule_id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `version` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `changed_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `change_reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_rule_version` (`rule_id`,`version`),
  CONSTRAINT `rule_versions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`rule_id`) REFERENCES `rule_nodes` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
